verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a 'remote sandbox' feature (COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH) for running Python code on bulk/large tool responses, and a docs teaser mentioning 'sand[box]', but nothing describes an isolated test environment that lets a user exercise Composio's actual toolkits/connected accounts without touching live production data or APIs — connections like Instagram/Gmail appear to hit real production endpoints (per composio-comm-1/2).
